name: Da Nang Cathedral
kicker: The pink church called the rooster church
summary: Look up at the pink Gothic church on Tran Phu, nearly 70 meters tall, with a rose window and a rooster on the spire. Locals call it Con Ga, the rooster church. Built in 1923, it takes a few minutes on a river morning, Monday to Saturday, in modest dress.
getThere: 156 Tran Phu. Walk from the river, or Grab from My Khe.
heroCaption: The pink facade and the rose window

notice.title: The rooster is Peter's
notice.body: The bird on the roof is often called a French emblem. The parish explains it as Peter's rooster from the Gospel, a call to wake up. The church's official name, Nhà thờ giáo xứ Chánh tòa Đà Nẵng, dates from 1963.

body: Give it the few minutes a church front takes, on a river morning. The church was built in 1923, nearly 70 meters high, under Father Louis Vallet, in a Gothic form with a rose window. Behind it is a grotto of Our Lady arranged after Lourdes. People in the city call it Con Gà, the rooster church, for the bird on the roof.
Visitors are welcome Monday to Saturday, in the morning and the afternoon, with a break at midday. Sunday is not in the visitor window. Dress modestly.

figures.caption: The spire and the cross
figures.alt: The cathedral spire and cross against a blue sky

gettingThere: The church is at 156 Trần Phú. From a river hotel, walk to that street and ask for Nhà thờ Con Gà. From My Khe, take a Grab.
hours: Monday to Saturday, 08:00–11:30 and 13:30–16:30 (parish notice, in force from 1 Jan 2023). Sunday is not in the visitor window.
closed: Sunday, for visitors. No other closing day listed.
